November 2

To Jenny Lind

By Edmund Gosse (1849–1928)

A famous Swedish singer who died on Nov. 2, 1887.
T
HEY
 call thee Nightingale, who know thee not!
But Philomel’s light voice within her tree
Betrays an instinct of her transient lot;
As flowers to gems are, so are birds to thee.
